title: The Inertia Default
coreMove: Ask what is continuing only because it was already moving.
sourcePressure: Inertia is the default of comfort, habit, familiarity, and change resistance. The chapter contrasts passive continuation with deliberately built clarity-supporting defaults.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Mistaking inertia for laziness or motivation failure instead of familiarity defending itself.

sourceAnchors.name: inertia in the four-default map
sourceAnchors.detail: the official excerpt-backed bundle names inertia as one of the four defaults and the heading index supports comfort, habit, change resistance, and familiarity
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Inertia often does not feel like a decision; it feels like the least strange next step.
